checks.name: whitespace
checks.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); original=Path('~/Workspace/alien_planet_chronicles'); before=json.loads(Path('../h002-before.json').read_text()); errors=[]; checked=0
for b in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
 if not b.is_file() or b.suffix not in ('.md','.py','.json','.yaml'):continue
 name=b.relative_to(root).as_posix();a=original/name
 if name in before and a.read_bytes()==b.read_bytes():continue
 checked+=1
 p=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--no-index','--check','--',str(a) if a.is_file() else '/dev/null',str(b)],capture_output=True,text=True)
 if p.returncode not in (0,1) or p.stdout or p.stderr:errors.append({'file':name,'code':p.returncode,'detail':p.stdout+p.stderr})
print({'files_checked':checked,'errors':errors,'note':'--no-index returns 1 for differing files; whitespace faults produce diagnostics'})
raise SystemExit(bool(errors))
PY
